# netboxplugins_dns_zone (Data Source)

Reads one NetBox DNS zone.

Plugin: `netbox-plugin-dns` (experimental). API: `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/zones/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netboxplugins_dns_zone" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}

data "netboxplugins_dns_zone" "by_filter" {
  filters = { name = "example" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) NetBox query parameters on `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/zones/` that select exactly one object, for example `{ name = "example" }`.
- `id` (Number) NetBox ID of the object. Set either `id` or `filters`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean)
- `admin_c` (Number) Administrative contact for the domain. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `billing_c` (Number) Billing contact for the domain. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values as strings; lists and objects as JSON (`jsonencode`).
- `default_ttl` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `dnssec_policy` (Number) DNSSEC policy to apply to the zone. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `domain_status` (String) One of `addPeriod`, `autoRenewPeriod`, `inactive`, `ok`, `pendingCreate`, `pendingDelete`, `pendingRenew`, `pendingRestore`, `pendingTransfer`, `pendingUpdate`, `redemptionPeriod`, `renewPeriod`, `serverDeleteProhibited`, `serverHold`, `serverRenewProhibited`, `serverTransferProhibited`, `serverUpdateProhibited`, `transferPeriod`, `clientDeleteProhibited`, `clientHold`, `clientRenewProhibited`, `clientTransferProhibited`, `clientUpdateProhibited`, ``.
- `expiration_date` (String)
- `inline_signing` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `nameservers` (Set of Number) Nameservers for the zone. NetBox IDs of the referenced objects.
- `owner` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `parental_agents` (List of String)
- `registrant` (Number) Registrant of the domain. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `registrar` (Number) Registrar the domain is registered with. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `registry_domain_id` (String)
- `rfc2317_parent_managed` (Boolean) The parent zone for the RFC2317 zone is managed by NetBox DNS.
- `rfc2317_parent_zone` (Number) RFC2317 parent zone of the zone. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `rfc2317_prefix` (String) RFC2317 IPv4 prefix with a length of at least 25 bits.
- `soa_expire` (Number)
- `soa_minimum` (Number)
- `soa_mname` (Number) Primary nameserver for the zone. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `soa_refresh` (Number)
- `soa_retry` (Number)
- `soa_rname` (String) Contact email for the zone.
- `soa_serial` (Number)
- `soa_serial_auto` (Boolean) Automatically generate the SOA serial number.
- `soa_ttl` (Number)
- `status` (String) One of `active`, `reserved`, `deprecated`, `parked`, `dynamic`, `external`, ``.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag names.
- `tech_c` (Number) Technical contact for the domain. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `tenant` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `view` (Number) View the zone belongs to. NetBox ID of the referenced object.
